assessment: This fundamental study study reveals that phorbol esters have a stimulatory effect on chromaffin cell secretion via ubMunc13-2 but an inhibitory effect via Munc13-1. These convincingly demonstrated, opposing effects of the two closely related Munc13 paralogs are surprising and, although it remains unclear how these findings relate to the mechanism of synaptic vesicle release, the study reveals important differences between the two isoforms of this central priming protein.
